# On This Day

> > Daily historical events, birthdays, deaths, and anniversaries from 4000 BC to present across world history, science, culture, and sport.

On This Day is a comprehensive historical reference covering events, notable figures, and milestones organized by date and year. The site features biographical directories, year-specific timelines from medieval periods through modern history, and curated lists of historical figures including scientists, leaders, and cultural icons from around the world.

## Key Topics

- historical events
- this day in history
- famous people and biographies
- birthdays and deaths
- medieval history
- world history timelines
- scientific discoveries
- military battles and conflicts
- anniversaries and commemorations
- historical figures by nationality
- calendar-based history
- biographical directories
- year-specific events
- generation and era filters
- alphabetical people indexes

## Core Pages

- [On This Day - Today in History, Film, Music and Sport](https://www.onthisday.com/): Homepage featuring daily historical events, birthdays, deaths from 4000 BC
- [List of Famous People and Historical Figures - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/famous-people.php): Directory of notable figures including Federer, Napoleon, Columbus by category

## Historical Year References

- [Year 1000 - Historical Events and Notable People - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/date/1000): Medieval year 1000: Stephen I of Hungary, Battle of Svolder, Viking Age
- [Year 1200 - Historical Events and Notable People - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/date/1200): 13th century year 1200: Treaty of Le Goulet, European royalty events
- [Historical Events in 1800 - On This Day](https://www.onthisday.com/events/date/1800): 37 events from 1800: Dutch East India Company, US Congress, Battle of Novi
